span.p:
Narrow citing works per claim via evidence sub-chapter refs
{5.4.1} → refs sm → seed dois → snowball edges → citing works
(subset: sm only — subset: all skips this)
[llm_candidate_scope_parquet]

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Route NLI-flagged pairs (label == REFUTES | uncertain), intersect with candidate scope (subset: sm)
then call the LLM per (claim, work) — NLI label + confidence as prior
→ SUPPORTS / REFUTES / NEI + verbatim quote
[llm_verification_parquet]

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Segment each BM into claims — per granularity:
naive_bm: evidence-delimited, one claim per sentence-group ending in a {ref} (+ a separate bm_label claim) — 2-17 claims per BM
complete_bm: whole bm_description/bm_label as one claim each — 2 per BM (1 if identical)
atomic_bm: split at EVERY evidence brace, then LLM-complete elliptical fragments into self-contained claims (confidence qualifiers extracted to their own column, same as naive_bm)
[nli_ready_evidence_parquet] → QA report [bm_split_report_table -> bm_split_report_html]

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Classify each citing work vs one BM claim
premise = clean(title + abstract)
hypothesis = one evidence-segmented BM claim
→ SUPPORTS / REFUTES / NEI
[nli_claim_units_evidence -> nli_claim_units_evidence_flat -> nli_scores_by_claim_evidence]
